card.fact_statement: Huadanosaurus features a generally deep skull and mandible.
card.source_span: The generally deep skull and mandible, as well as the fused nasal, are all adaptations towards resisting high levels of biting stress.

card.fact_statement: The ischium of the Tameryraptor holotype pointed almost directly horizontally.
card.source_span: Uniquely, the ischium pointed almost directly horizontally.
